plan.goal: Collect, analyze, and rank representative NAD(P)HX repair protein sequence candidates for ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase and NAD(P)HX epimerase activities.
assumptions: Gene Ontology molecular-function annotations are sufficient to retrieve relevant representative sequence candidates for both activities.
A small GO-linked retrieval set per activity is an acceptable local starting point for representative sequence analysis.

Some organisms may encode these repair functions as separate proteins while others may encode fused or closely related proteins; ranking should compare the combined retrieved candidate pool without assuming one architecture.
